referenceRole: Art treatment, atmosphere, and palette only; not source layout or branding

concept.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined design concept board with three complete legible application screens stacked vertically, each wide 16:9: opening, lesson, practice. Reference the supplied Altura image ONLY for its painterly finely pixelated atmosphere, dusk blue/lavender/peach/gold lighting, not its layout, mountains or airplane. Product: Git Multiverse, UF EMBS beginner Git workshop. Screen 1: slim header UF EMBS / Git Multiverse, Slides Practice Reference navigation; immersive floating islands drifting above peach clouds, quiet blue sky left for expressive ivory serif headline 'Your project. With a memory.' Small description 'Learn Git, one checkpoint at a time.' Button 'Begin the journey'. A thin gold path with three labeled commit checkpoints in lower right; small Previous 01 / 35 Next controls at bottom. Screen 2: same slim chrome on warm ivory, title 'Choose what goes into a commit.' readable sans short explanation, substantial diagram Working files -> Next snapshot -> Saved checkpoint with sensor-config.json staged and team-notes.md outside snapshot. A calm narrow landscape strip anchors bottom. Separate 'Stage sensor setting' diagram button. Present control top right. Screen 3: same ivory chrome, practice title 'Stage only the sensor setting', one dark dusk terminal on left, compact live repository companion on right showing Working files and Next snapshot. No dashboard card grid. Match simple existing Slides/Practice learning flow. Elegant Georgia-style serif headings, clear sans controls, monospaced code, restrained thin lavender borders, dusk ink. All UI remains live code in implementation; do not add unrelated copy or metrics. Make cohesive full screen concepts with readable controls, not a website marketing layout. Use attached image as art direction input.

landscape.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background asset, panoramic 16:9, no text or UI. Using the supplied Altura image as style and lighting reference only, paint an original quiet sky world of FLOATING ISLANDS: beautifully detailed stratified rocky islands with small grassy tops floating above immense soft cloud banks, receding into atmospheric distance. One large island on right lower third, two smaller islands through middle distance, tiny lavender silhouettes on horizon. Finely pixel-painted with the sophisticated painterly texture and luminous warm light of an animated film; not coarse eight-bit blocks. Palette dusk blue #405A83 and lavender #A394C2 sky, apricot peach #F4B58F clouds and lit rock, pale gold #F8D69B sun rims. The left upper half must be calm deep dusk blue negative space suitable for ivory heading overlay; cloud highlights occupy mainly right and bottom. Balanced calm adventurous mood. No airplane, no buildings, no characters, no stars, no neon, no text, no logos, no UI, no frames, no drawn graph connections (these will be live SVG). Full bleed artwork with generous sky. This asset supports the Git Multiverse learning app.
